newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 at record close on last 1996 session.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 at record close on last 1996 session.

text.p: The UK'S FTSE 100 index on Tuesday hit a record close of 4,118.5 on the truncated last session of 1996, its fifth new closing peak of the past month and giving a gain of 11.6 percent from the end of 1995.

The increase compares with the FTSE 100's 20.3 percent gain in 1995 and its 10.0 percent decline in 1994, yet is well below the 35 percent rise in 1989 -- the index's best annual performance since it was created in January 1984.
